item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WduIMOAdIyg

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解黑吉即將推出的旗艦級98配列機械鍵盤SK98，掌握其兼具厚重質感與包豪斯風格的工藝亮點。
  • 解析五層消音填充的Gasket結構與客製化荔枝軸，一窺極致聲學表現與流暢敲擊手感的軟硬體配置。
  • 見證鍵盤界革命性的AI客製化燈效與便捷網頁驅動，體驗動動嘴就能自動編程RGB燈光動效的全新科技。

摘要

鋁合包豪斯美學與98實用配列

作者展示了黑吉即將推出的工程樣品鍵盤SK98。這款鍵盤毛重接近三公斤，外觀延續經典的包豪斯風格，上蓋由整塊6063鋁合金經過CNC精密切削與噴砂工藝製成，觸感如肌膚般細膩。不同於傳統全鋁鍵盤，SK98下蓋特別選用ABS塑料打造，藉此容納環繞燈帶與獨特的底部投影燈光。作者指出，相較於缺少數字區的87鍵與體積龐大的104鍵，這款98配列在保留數字小鍵盤的同時維持小巧體積，無論是日常辦公、程式開發還是電競遊戲都能完美勝任。

極致五層消音填充與荔枝軸手感

在內部架構上，作者特別強調SK98採用了標準的Gasket結構，並搭配霧面半透PC定位板與南向LED燈位，連長鍵空格處都設有多顆燈珠以實現柔和均勻的光效漫射。軸體方面搭載了客製化線性荔枝軸，具備觸發滑順、聲音清脆及行程適中的全方位特性。鍵盤內部更塞滿了Poron夾心棉、軸下墊、PET墊、底棉及底層矽膠等五層消音填充，從側面即可看出極為緊湊紮實的堆疊，將空腔音抑制到極致。

便攜網頁驅動與革命性AI自定義燈效

作者對鍵盤長按FN即可直接喚醒網頁端驅動的設計讚不絕口，使用者能輕鬆自訂四組層級設定檔、配置SOCD與防抖時間。更引人注目的是其領先業界搭載的AI客製化燈效技術。除內建13種豐富RGB燈效外，使用者只需以自然語言下達指令，例如「生成常亮彩虹光」或「五秒內左右移動變色的粒子效果」，系統便會由AI自動生成代碼並一鍵匯入。作者總結這款兼具鋁金屬高級質感與頂尖科技的「全能型」鍵盤表現非凡，並邀請觀眾一同構思專屬的手工訂製線材細節。

================================================

This is a new keyboard model soon to be released by our old friend at HEIJI, model SK98, and the layout is quite obvious. The one I have isn't the final mass-produced version yet; they still have some minor issues to iron out, and they need everyone's input to see how to refine the details. The gross weight is probably around three kilos—c'mon, cameraman, give it a lift. Manual, dust cover...what style of keyboard is this? >> Bauhaus style, right? Gunmetal gray paired with black translucent keycaps. It has a unique texture when you touch it, especially the entire top cover of the case. It's a solid piece of 6063 aluminum, CNC-machined and then sandblasted; as you can see, it has a skin-like texture that feels very special. To put it simply, this is a solid aluminum block keyboard. Isn't that design descriptive? When I see the style, it feels very,. very familiar. A few years ago, there was a keyboard called the Nature80, which used roughly this same design language. Do you know how much one cost back then ? Every corner has only a tiny chamfer, giving the edges a very sharp and clean look. But the front of the keyboard is quite different—look at this cutout here. Can anyone guess what makes it special? The second feature is that it houses a light strip inside, so unlike.

traditional full-aluminum keyboards, the bottom shell is made of ABS plastic. Few manufacturers make full-size aluminum keyboards these days, and this one features a 98 layout. I used to play with 87 layouts, but many people would say, "I need a number pad. " Well, here's your number pad, but it’s not as bulky as a 104-key board, so in terms of positioning, it's perfect for. professionals, gamers, or even daily office work for programmers. This keyboard is versatile, and it has plenty of small details, like a dedicated CNC aluminum knob for switching between three connection modes . It's on now—looks good, doesn't it? Look at the mounting plate; it’s a translucent PC plate to better diffuse the light, and clearly, it’s south-facing LEDs. Also, check out the spacebar—it doesn't just have two lights, there are several in there. And count them, at the bottom of the keyboard, you'll see a projection light area. It echoes the keyboard's main lighting effects. You might wonder if it's just one type of light, but it's not just ARGB; it's the third keyboard to support AI-customized lighting effects. >> The other two >> I can't name the brands, but the other two are compact keyboards and are both magnetic-switch keyboards, so clearly, those aren't products for the average.

user. But this Skyloong SK98 is all about full coverage, providing all the keys for everyone. Gasket structure, south-facing switches with light guide plates. Mine is called the Lychee switch, a custom switch from Skyloong. Linear feel. Crisp sound. Smooth keystrokes. Medium travel distance; this is a true. all-rounder, perfect for both typing and gaming. The switch design is clearly built entirely for lighting. From the side, you can see it's fully packed with sound dampening: a PC plate , poron foam, switch pads, plus PET, bottom foam, and silicone at the base— five layers of filler. Close-up on the keycaps; can you see that unique skin-like texture? 2.4 G toggle switch. Easy to use by touch. Almost all Skyloong keyboards have a shortcut to access the web-based driver. , which is a great feature. I have to do it every time, just long-press FN to automatically open the web-based driver. Keys are fully customizable, with custom layers. You can create four profiles and switch them instantly, supporting advanced settings like SOCD, MT, and TGL. You can also set the keyboard's auto-sleep timer, lighting timeout, key response time, and debounce settings. Look, the second function is the lighting effects.

It's not just one color; the richness of the colors and that soft, glowing ambient feel......are controlled perfectly. There are 13 preset lighting effects, and you can change the colors yourself. Adjust the brightness. Dynamic flickering. Wow. And look, for each item, you can choose between a single color or RGB. See, this is what RGB looks like. Color flow, RGB breathing, color shifting, and you can adjust the speed. There are so many options to tweak, like ripple breathing, etc. Oh, look, it's various flashing RGB colors, kind of like a Matrix-style effect in color. Besides that, you can see it also has a music mode. In the past, I definitely would have demonstrated the music mode, where it pulses like a spectrum, but today we can just skip that function. Why? Since this is a keyboard with AI lighting effects, it comes pre-loaded with three AI light presets: rainbow gradient, as you can see, and colorful fireworks. Look at it setting off fireworks here; see how restrained the colors are? The third preset is called "Wave with Heart Follow," so watch closely when you’re courting someone—here comes the heart, here it comes. The heart is here . Whatever else you click after that doesn't really matter; the important.

thing is the AI lighting. Ask it to "generate a steady rainbow glow," and it will automatically generate code based on the file guidelines. Paste it in, import the preset, and now look—our keyboard has turned into a steady, constant rainbow lighting effect . "Help me generate a particle effect where particles move left and right, traveling from one side of the keyboard to the other in five seconds while changing colors." That’s a bit tricky, so let's see if it can program that for us. Look at that particle effect. You can freely adjust the AI lighting to match your vision; all you have to do is talk, no manual work required. What do you think, guys? This is the hybrid of an aluminum chassis and a high-end build, a top-tier "all-rounder " layout. So here is the question: what kind of ideas do I need you guys to help me with? The guys aren't too happy with the included cable, so I hope you can help design a premium DLC cable that matches its quality and style. I’m thinking of a coiled cable—let's hand-craft one. Doesn't that make a better match? Lao Zhang's taste is really worth praising this time.

=============

item.itunes:title: 几十块钱捡漏大牌智能会议音箱？翻车！捡垃圾
item.itunes:author: 老张是大佬
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rVnsEfrePDQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭密知名企業會議設備大牌 Polycom 會議音箱在二手市場的「撿漏」實測與踩坑真相。
  • 了解專業會議音箱採用 PoE 供電 的限制與家用連接時可能遇到的供電困擾。
  • 實際測試會議音箱播放流行音樂的音質表現，打破「大牌商務設備聽歌一樣出色」的迷思。

摘要

二手撿漏企業級會議揚聲器

作者受到群友的推薦投稿，在二手平台花費 97 元購入了一台知名商務品牌 Polycom（寶利通） 的 Trio 8800 智慧會議音箱。這款設備常見於大型企業會議室，具備多角度收音麥克風、揚聲器及一鍵靜音鍵，並配有一塊小型觸控螢幕與 NFC 模組，但其特殊之處在於機身沒有常規電源孔，完全依賴 PoE 網路孔供電。

繁瑣的供電與卡頓的系統體驗

因為設備未附帶專用變壓器，作者先找來一顆 40W 的 PoE 供電器將其啟動。該設備內建 Android 智慧系統，但實際滑動觸控螢幕時反應極為延遲，操作體驗非常不跟手。此外，作者嘗試使用 NFC 快速配對 藍牙功能也未能成功，最終只能透過手機手動搜尋藍牙完成連線。

音質翻車與刺耳的聽覺體驗

在成功連線並播放音樂後，設備的音質表現令人大失所望。人聲高頻部分的齒音嚴重變形，整體聲音缺乏解析力與動態，聽感極差。作者感嘆這台機器完全只值二手買來的幾十元價格，甚至懷疑自己是否被群友故意推坑開玩笑。

升級供電仍難以挽救

面對攝影師提出是否因供電功率不足導致音質劣化，作者又額外花了 100 元購入 60W 高功率 PoE 供電器進行二次驗證。然而更換強效電源後，其音質依然只有普通廉價電視揚聲器的水準。作者量測後發現內部喇叭單元僅約 2 英吋左右，本質上就是專為人聲會議調校的設備，根本不適合用來聽音樂，徹底宣告撿漏翻車。

=============
